text:
julie_customer: hey team — EdgeChain customer hitting 403s from SSO after LB cert rotation last night. Only on Dedicated us-west. repro steps below, server logs say 'missing sso claim' even though header present at ingress.

julie_customer: repro steps: 1) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-SSO-CLAIM: user=alice;role=admin" https://dedicated.us-west.internal/api/health 2) response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden, server log: auth middleware: claim not found

sarah_support: thanks — can you paste raw bytes/tcpdump of the proxied request? my hunch: header folding or order change after HAProxy->Envoy mTLS. seen similar where semicolons cause split.

julie_customer: i pulled a capture from a non-TLS test vhost (HAProxy terminating TLS -> clear http to envoy). snippet below: 

--- begin capture ---
GET /api/health HTTP/1.1
Host: dedicated.us-west.internal
User-Agent: curl/7.85.0
Accept: */*
Authorization: Bearer abc.def.ghi
Cookie: session=xyz; Path=/; HttpOnly
X-SSO-CLAIM: user=alice;
 role=admin
Connection: close
--- end capture ---

julie_customer: note X-SSO-CLAIM got folded across a newline (";\n role=admin") — server side parses only first line, treats role missing.

sarah_support: that matches header-folding bug. some proxies will fold on "; " boundaries or rewrap long headers. quick workaround: put the claim into a single token-safe header (eg X-SSO-B64) or JWT in Authorization.

devon_oncall: we rolled mTLS on the LB at 02:11 UTC (see deploy-bot). HAProxy 2.4 changed default header normalization in our build. can you share your haproxy config for that vhost? also which Envoy version on the Dedicated node? envoy header handling differs across versions.

mike_enginfra: if HAProxy is doing line wrapping, config flags exist: try adding "http-request set-header X-SSO-CLAIM %[req.hdr(X-SSO-CLAIM)]" to force a single header line, or disable header folding via the build option. also check if "h1-to-h2" conversion is enabled; that can introduce reformatting.

anish_neteng: quick inspection command if you can run on the LB: sudo tcpdump -nn -s0 -A -c 100 host <dedicated-ip> and look at the HTTP payload after TLS termination. if still TLS at LB you need to decrypt or use HAProxy capture: 
  tcpdump command: sudo tcpdump -nn -s0 -A port 80 and filter by host.

julie_customer: here's the exact haproxy backend snippet we use: 

backend dedicated-http
  mode http
  option forwardfor
  server d-01 10.10.10.12:8080 check

nothing fancy, no explicit http-request set-header. We tested adding the set-header and base64 workaround locally:

# curl test that works (base64 header)
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer abc.def.ghi" -H "X-SSO-B64: eyJ1c2VyIjoiYWxpY2UiLCJyb2xlIjoiYWRtaW4ifQ==" https://dedicated.us-west.internal/api/health

response: 200 OK (auth succeeds).

sarah_support: ok good; confirms HAProxy wrapped the original header. Actionable remediation: short-term — use X-SSO-B64 or put claim in JWT Authorization. Medium-term — eng-infra to pin HAProxy behavior or set explicit http-request set-header to normalize. Long-term — update auth middleware to reassemble folded headers (defensive).

mike_enginfra: i'll open INFRA-4721 to track: check HAProxy 2.4 defaults, add canary change to config (http-request set-header) for us-west dedicated pool, roll to 10% then 100% if green. i'll also validate envoy 1.25 vs 1.24 differences.

devon_oncall: action list: 1) julie_customer to confirm base64 workaround in production test by 18:00 PT. 2) mike_enginfra to create infra ticket and schedule canary. 3) dev team to add header-reassembly in auth middleware PR. 4) support to notify customer of temporary mitigation.

julie_customer: confirmed — base64 workaround accepted by customer, auth passes. we'll keep traffic on rollback plan until INFRA-4721 patch lands. thanks all :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: deploy event: mTLS gateway change rolled at 2951234600 for us-west — rollback job scheduled.

julie_customer: marking this thread resolved for now, will reopen if rollback not applied or if we see other claim encodings failing.
